Quick whip pan.

She opens the hotel room door—

The glam team is already waiting outside.

One makeup artist laughs:

Finally! Let's go!

The beat drops.

Everyone rushes inside.

Cut.

PART 2

No pause.

No calm moments.

...Perfect.

Aurelia!

One more!

You're next.

Silence.

Boom.

Step.

BOOM.

BOOM.

Photographers.

Standing ovation.

Outside...

She exits the venue.

Luxury car waiting.

Paparazzi surround her.

Small confident smile.

Door closes.

Music stops instantly.

Black screen.

AURELIA
